units.source_text: 这阿阇梨对冷泉院也很亲近，常往伺候，教授经文。

en.t: This ajari was also very close to the Reizei In and often went to serve him and teach him the scriptures.

units.source_text: 有一次入京，顺便赴院参见。

en.t: Once, when he came into the capital, he took the opportunity to visit the retired emperor.

units.source_text: 冷泉院照例正在诵读应习的佛经，便将种种疑义向他叩问。

en.t: As usual, Reizei In was reciting the Buddhist scriptures he was studying, and he questioned the ajari about various doubts.

units.source_text: 阿阇梨乘机告道：“八亲王深通内典，真乃大智大慧啊！

en.t: Seizing the occasion, the ajari said, “The Eighth Prince has a profound command of the Buddhist teachings and is truly a man of great wisdom and insight.

units.source_text: 多分是具有宿世佛缘而降生于世的人。

en.t: He must surely have been born into this world with a karmic bond to Buddhism from former lives.

units.source_text: 他屏绝尘虑，专心学佛，其志望诚无异于圣僧。”

en.t: He has shut out worldly cares and devotes himself wholly to Buddhist study, and in his aspiration he is no different from a holy monk.”

units.source_text: 冷泉院说：“他还不曾出家么？

en.t: Reizei In said, “Has he still not taken the tonsure?

units.source_text: 此间一班青年人替他起个别名，叫作‘在俗圣僧’。

en.t: The young men here have given him a nickname and call him the ‘holy monk in lay life.’

units.source_text: 真可令人感佩啊！”

en.t: It is truly something to admire.”

units.source_text: 此时宰相中将薰君亦侍奉在侧，他窃自寻思：“我正痛感人世之无聊，只是不曾公然诵经礼佛。

en.t: At that time Kaoru, the Councillor Captain, was also in attendance nearby, and he thought privately, “I too feel keenly how empty human life is, but I have never openly recited sutras or worshiped the Buddha.

units.source_text: 虚徒岁月，实甚可惜！”

en.t: To let the years pass in vain is truly a great pity.”

units.source_text: 又念八亲王在俗而为圣僧，不知其心境究竟如何，便倾耳而听阿阇梨的话。

en.t: He also wondered what state of mind the Eighth Prince had attained, being a holy monk while still a layman, and so he listened closely to the ajari’s words.

units.source_text: 阿阇梨又说：“八亲王早有出家之志。

en.t: The ajari continued, “The Eighth Prince has long wished to leave the world and become a monk.

units.source_text: 据说以前为了琐事缠身，犹豫不决。

en.t: It is said that in the past he was held back by various worldly matters and could not make up his mind.

units.source_text: 今则可怜两个无母的女儿，不忍弃下。

en.t: Now he pities his two motherless daughters and cannot bear to leave them behind.

units.source_text: 他正为此愁叹呢。”

en.t: That is what he is grieving over now.”

units.source_text: 这阿阇梨却爱好音乐，又道：“再说，那两位女公子琴筝合奏之声，与宇治川波声相应和，真美妙呢！

en.t: This ajari, however, loved music, and he added, “Besides, the sound of the two young ladies playing koto and zither together, harmonizing with the waves of the Uji River, is truly exquisite.

units.source_text: 极乐世界的音乐也不过如此吧。”

en.t: Even the music of the Pure Land could hardly be more than this.”

units.source_text: 他这古风的赞美，使得冷泉院微笑，说道：“

en.t: This old-fashioned praise of his made Reizei In smile, and he said, “

units.source_text: 这两个女孩生长在这圣僧之家，料想她们不谙世俗行为，

en.t: Those two girls have grown up in the household of this holy monk, so one would expect them to know little of worldly manners,

units.source_text: 岂知长于音乐，真乃难得之事。

en.t: yet to think that they are accomplished in music is truly a rare thing.

units.source_text: 亲王挂念她们，不忍舍弃，为此忧愁烦恼。

en.t: The Prince is anxious about them and cannot bear to abandon them, and that is why he is troubled and distressed.

units.source_text: 我的寿命如能比他略长，不妨交付与我代为保护吧。”

en.t: If my life should last even a little longer than his, he might well entrust them to me and let me protect them in his place.”

units.source_text: 这冷泉院是桐壶院第十皇子，乃八亲王之弟，

en.t: This Reizei In was the tenth imperial prince of Kiritsubo In and the younger brother of the Eighth Prince.

units.source_text: 他想起了朱雀院将三公主托付已故六条院主的旧事，

en.t: He recalled the old story of Suzaku In entrusting the Third Princess to the late lord of Rokujo In,

units.source_text: 希望这两女公子来做他寂寞时的游伴。

en.t: and he hoped that these two young ladies might become companions to amuse him in his loneliness.

units.source_text: 薰君反而不起这种念头，

en.t: Kaoru, on the other hand, did not entertain such thoughts.

units.source_text: 他只想拜访八亲王，看看他专心学佛之状。

en.t: He only wanted to visit the Eighth Prince and see how he devoted himself to Buddhist study.

units.source_text: 这愿望越来越深切了。

en.t: That wish grew deeper and more urgent.
